Name: The Ranch Expansion Marnie and Jas
Author: lemurkat
Description:
COMING [s]SOON[/s] [i]EVENTUALLY[/i]: Will Marnie and Marlon make for a healthier match ... or will Lewis try and win her back?
****************************

In the core game, Marnie has very limited dialogue and little personality growth. This mod adds seasonal dialogue that changes as your friendship grows. She will discuss her relationship with Lewis, and her family members Jas and Shane. It also gives her more of a life beyond the desk (although she will still man the shop Weds-Sunday).

Also included is more dialogue, character development, and heart scenes for Jas - learn more about her family history, and help her determine her future!

Adds heart events at 2, 4, 5, 8 and 10-hearts (6-heart scene from core game remains unchanged and is an important part of the story line) for Marnie, and 2, 4, 7, 8 and 10-heart scenes for Jas. Canon scenes involving both characters remain unchanged.
(Jas's 7 heart scene is dependent on having seen Shane's 8 heart scene).

[list]
[*]Configurable option to use my tweaked Marnie sprite is not updated for 1.5 additions. Use [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/1073357-diverse-stardew-valley-shane-jas-and-marnie-dsv-seasonal-outfits]DSV[/url]﻿ instead.
[*]Not compatible with any mods that adjust Marnie and Jas's dialogue.
[*]Additional sprites have been created for Jas. A compatibility patch has been added in DSV for: [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/1073357-diverse-stardew-valley-shane-jas-and-marnie-dsv-seasonal-outfits]Jas[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/1073313-diverse-stardew-valley-marlon-gunther-and-morris-dsv-seasonal-outfits]Marlon[/url]﻿
[*]Compatible with Karmylla's Immersive Maps and Stardew Valley Reimagined 2.
[*]Heart events are now compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded.
[*]If you notice duplicate Marlon or Marnie during festivals: Festival changes can be adjusted in the config. 
[*]Lore and personality of characters may contradict SVE or other mods. Marlon has a built in personality change if Make Marlon Real is installed.
[*]Not tested, but should work okay with the mods that chain Marnie to her desk, but her dialogue may seem out of context. [spoiler]It will attempt (and may suceed) to change her schedule on Mondays after her 10-heart event.[/spoiler]
[*]Recommended companion mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22955]TenThousandCats's Immersive Shane[/url]﻿. It has been playtested with it installed, and is compatible, although it will adjust Shane's schedule [spoiler]on the 28th spring each year[/spoiler]
[*]Recommended companion mod:[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5295] Mr. Ginger[/url]﻿. This mod is where his character began!
[*]Best played on a new save. There's some little surprises early ingame that you'll miss if you're already more than two hearts with Marnie, and one will only happen in year 1 [spoiler]Hint: Talk to Marnie on the 2nd Summer and keep an eye on Lewis.[/spoiler]
[*]Also you may like to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6046]Tell Everyone[/url]﻿ about Marnie and Lewis's relationship.
[*]Adjusts Penny's schedule on Tuesday's so she stays with Jas after class, so she isn't home alone.
[/list]
Note: This Mod does not cast Lewis in a favorable light. If you are fond of our Mayor, you might like to skip this one - or petition me to write an alternate 10-heart scene! (I'm not kidding, I've definitely considered it).

** You will see references to "Mona". This is the canon Mona, NOT the custom NPC Mona.**.

*********
It is compatible with [b]Marnie Deserves Better[/b] and[b] Life Cycle Marnie and Lewis[/b],HOWEVER, if you trigger this 10-heart event before installing either of those two mods, it will lead to issues relating to dialogue and behaviour. Should you do so, you will need to use Event Repeater to remove Mail ID: LeaveLewis and  Event: 50706110. 
**********

[b]Installation instructions:[/b]
1. Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher
2. Drop the files into your "Mods" file.
3. New save recommended for the full experience!

Pls report any bugs in the "bugs" section and logs encouraged. I can't fix it if I don't know it exists! I'm still playtesting the new 1.13 content patcher stuff, so there may be updates tweaking the festivals. Also Jas asks quite a few questions, and errors in these lock the game, so please inform me the moment you find them.
